paragraphs: Rav Mari son of Rav Bizna.
He is mentioned in Beitzah 28b, and it is implied there that he lived in the time of Rav Yosef.[^1][^2]

notes.text: כח: gives Beitzah 28b under the colon convention, without independent named-edition verification.
ומשמע means it is implied: contemporaneity with Rav Yosef remains Hyman’s inference, not an explicit dated statement or new historical finding. All three Rav titles are full.
